description: Gives Claude the project's TaskGraph state and workflow rules at session start and after compaction, and reminds it once per session to log a note on the task in progress before it stops. Does nothing outside a TaskGraph project.

hooks.command: d="${TASKGRAPH_PROJECT_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}}"; [ -f "$d/.taskgraph/config.json" ] || [ -f "$d/.taskgraph/tasks/tasks.json" ] || exit 0; in=; while IFS= read -r l || [ -n "$l" ]; do in="$in$l"; done; case "$in" in *'"session_id":"'*) sid=${in#*\"session_id\":\"}; sid=${sid%%\"*};; *) sid=;; esac; case "$sid" in ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9_-]*) ;; *) t="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/taskgraph-$(id -u 2>/dev/null)"; mkdir -m 700 "$t" 2>/dev/null; if [ -d "$t" ] && [ ! -L "$t" ] && [ -O "$t" ]; then m="$t/session-$sid"; case "$in" in *'"source":"compact"'*) [ -f "$m" ] || { date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ > "$m"; } 2>/dev/null;; *) { date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ > "$m"; } 2>/dev/null;; esac; fi;; esac; pre="This project tracks work in TaskGraph, but"; if ! command -v taskgraph >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "$pre the taskgraph CLI is not installed. Ask the user to run: npm install -g taskgraph-ai"; exit 0; fi; export TASKGRAPH_SKIP_AUTO_UPDATE=1; if out=$(taskgraph prime --project "$d" 2>/dev/null); then printf '%s\n' "$out"; else out=$(taskgraph prime --project "$d" 2>&1); case "$out" in *"nknown command"*) echo "$pre the installed taskgraph CLI is too old for the plugin. Ask the user to run: npm install -g taskgraph-ai@latest";; *) echo "$pre taskgraph prime failed:"; printf '%s\n' "$out";; esac; fi

d="${TASKGRAPH_PROJECT_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}}"; [ -f "$d/.taskgraph/config.json" ] || [ -f "$d/.taskgraph/tasks/tasks.json" ] || exit 0; in=; while IFS= read -r l || [ -n "$l" ]; do in="$in$l"; done; case "$in" in *'"stop_hook_active":true'*) exit 0;; *'"session_id":"'*) sid=${in#*\"session_id\":\"}; sid=${sid%%\"*};; *) exit 0;; esac; case "$sid" in ''|*[!A-Za-z0-9_-]*) exit 0;; esac; t="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/taskgraph-$(id -u 2>/dev/null)"; [ -d "$t" ] && [ ! -L "$t" ] && [ -O "$t" ] || exit 0; m="$t/session-$sid"; [ -f "$m" ] || exit 0; since=; shown=; { read -r since; read -r shown; } < "$m"; [ -n "$since" ] && [ -z "$shown" ] || exit 0; command -v taskgraph >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; export TASKGRAPH_SKIP_AUTO_UPDATE=1; msg=$(taskgraph prime --project "$d" --unnoted-since "$since" 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -n "$msg" ] || exit 0; { echo shown >> "$m"; } 2>/dev/null || exit 0; printf '%s\n' "$msg" >&2; exit 2
